sentences.text: The in-force evidence defines EMI as the equated monthly instalment payable by the borrower towards interest and principal, and it also says EPIs at monthly intervals are called EMIs.

The in-force loan documents on record show a different home loan with a sanctioned amount of ₹25,00,000, an interest rate of 8.5% p.a. floating, a loan term of 240 months, and an EMI amount of ₹21,696.
There is no in-force rule finding that applies to the requested 10,00,000 / 9% / 120-month scenario, and the evidence does not provide a verified EMI formula for that scenario.

missing.slot: EMI for INR 10,00,000 at 9% p.a. for 120 months
missing.searched: Looked for an in-force rule finding covering the requested loan terms and for evidence giving a verified EMI calculation basis for that scenario; none was provided.
